data.body:
Implementation complete, pushed as Gerrit change 1275 (commit e2c960417a, stacked on 1265/1262/1257).

scripts/probe_rebar.py (623 LOC) replaces scripts/probe-rebar.sh (deleted in same change). Continue-on-failure preserved explicitly: assertion helpers count+continue (never raise), exit non-zero iff any fail; _show_json/_list_json degrade parse failures to {} / [] so a following assertion FAILS and the run continues (the jq-pipeline analogue).

Assertion parity: all 140 shell assertions ported 1:1 by label, 0 retired. Side-by-side on the same build: shell 140/0, Python 140/0. Self-test PROBE_INJECT_FAIL=1: injected failure reported, run continues through all 19 sections, exit 1 (140 passed/1 failed).

Consumers re-pointed atomically: test.yml:128 + gerrit-verify.yaml:209 golden-path steps (python scripts/probe_rebar.py), tests/unit/test_probe_wired_into_ci.py anti-rot substring (2 passed), docs/releasing.md pipx examples, external-integration.yml comment. jq dependency dropped from the probe. pyproject per-file T201 entries added for probe_rebar.py + check_config_reads.py (scripts/ legitimate-print convention; make lint scopes src+tests so the 6754 script had missed the list silently).
